sentences.text: There are seventeen accused persons as disclosed in the FIR, out of whom, accused No.11 Jagdish Mohanlal Biyani is the present Applicant before this Court.
The Informant is one Laxman Ambadas Gore, age 62 years, a senior citizen who is one of the depositor in the Rajasthan Multi-State Co-operative Credit Society Limited.

entities.text: Rajasthan Multi-State Co-operative Credit Society Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: (For short, said Society)
5. With the assistance of learned Advocates for the parties, I have perused FIR and record available with the Court.

6. At the very outset, a bare perusal of the FIR would indicate that it relates to large scale misappropriation of funds mainly in the nature of deposits made by several depositors in the said society.
In this background, there are several accused persons as named in the FIR.
The learned Advocate for the Applicant, at the very outset would submit that the Applicant has never been a Director and/or the Office Bearer of the said Society.
He has made a categorical statement in this regard in the Anticipatory Bail Application.

Not just that, but he has drawn the Court's attention to several documents from the charge sheet khs/Aug.2025/1354  -3- itself beginning from a document dated 3 September 2023, which is a list of the Directors, where the present Applicant's name does not feature as a Director of the said Society.
He has also pointed out similar documents of the year 2023, which would also indicate that the name of the Applicant does not feature as a Director of the said Society.

It is pertinent to note that the charge sheet has been filed on 6 Jagdish Mohanlal Biyani vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58988867/
2 December 2024 in these proceedings.
7.

sentences.text: At this juncture, it is to be considered that similarly situated persons namely Accused No.2, the son of the Chairman of the said Society has been enlarged on regular bail by this Court ; Accused No.5 / Director of the said Society has been granted anticipatory bail by the Sessions Court.

Similar relief has been granted to Accused No.8,
Accused No.10 and Accused No.12 respectively.
Accused No.12 happens to be the CEO of the said Society.
The learned Advocate for the Applicant would urge that besides his name appearing in FIR on Sr.No.12, there is no specific role attributed to this Applicant.
There seems to be some substance in Mr.Ladda's submissions at this preliminary stage.

More particularly, considering that the Applicant has never been a Director or a Office Bearer of the said Society, meaning thereby that he was never involved in the administration or affairs of khs/Aug.2025/1354  -4- the said Society.
The learned Advocate for the Applicant would submit that he had taken some loan in private capacity from the said Society, which has been fully repaid.

8. Though the Application is listed for the first time, the learned APP would invite the Court's attention to the statement at page No.173, which is a part of the charge sheet to emphasize that the name of the Applicant is shown as the Director in the statement dated 31 March 2021.
Not just that, but the loan sanctioned against him is Rs.42,00,000/- and the outstanding is to the extent of more than 2 crores.

Prima facie, this appears to be an internal document of the said Society singed by the Chairman and the C.E.O., who, as noted above Jagdish Mohanlal Biyani vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58988867/
3 has been granted Anticipatory Bail by the Sessions Court.

sentences.text: 9. Considering the submissions made by the learned Advocate for the Applicant and the documents pointed out by him, these aspects would certainly require consideration.
However, in the factual conspectus, at this preliminary stage, physical custody of the Applicant may not be warranted at this juncture.

10. In the above facts and circumstances, the Applicant deserves to be protected by passing the following order :-
khs/Aug.2025/1354  -5-  ORDER (i) Until the adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicant Jagdish Mohanlal Biyani in connection with CR No.0274 of 2025 registered with Ambajogai Police Station, Dist.Beed for the offences punishable under Sections 34, 406, 409, 415, 420, 467 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 and under Sections 3, 4 an 5 of the Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (In Financial Establishments) Act, 1999, the Applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and shall attend the concerned police station on every Monday at 11:30 a.m., until further orders.

(iv) The Applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Court without prior permission/order of the Court, until further orders.

(v) The Applicant shall not influence the witness/es and/or tamper evidence in any manner whatsoever.
11.
List the proceedings for further consideration on 29 August 2025.
